g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 5 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/WS_DOPE.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1 phosphate-to-dopant in on -Y at z 160; N2 (B/P/As concentrate, BBr3 / POCl3 class) and N5 (dopant concentrate) out on +Y (schedule datums 600 clamped down: the 350 box predates them, W12)
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N-drain passes through the tray floor; the vent riser stands beside the tank to the envelope top (its 800 datum predates the box, W12)

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N5 carries the line-list classification solids (non-piped hand transfer): drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4). Atmospheric hose makeup by the connecting line at the face; the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text - no flange drawn
